# Barkin Kocatepe

> Personal portfolio of Barkin Kocatepe (also written Barkın Kocatepe), a software
> engineer specializing in cloud computing, distributed systems, and DevOps.
> Currently working in DevOps at Siemens and a Software Engineering student at
> Halic University. Previously interned at Microsoft on Azure Cloud, Azure AI, and
> DevOps / CI-CD tooling.
